headline: EMC fell 50.00% on 7.51 times volume, while TPOLY’s -10.00% open gap followed a disclosed debenture-interest default and +11.11% intraday move.
market_take: Coverage was mixed, with sharp weakness in EMC, KC, PF and F&D against gains in RML, CGD, NRF and several other names. Unusual trading was broad across PROP, CONS, FOOD and CONMAT, including high-volume alerts in ANAN, ORI, RT and BTG. Filings added company-specific risk around TPOLY, AKS, A5 and NVD.

sector_notes.note: EMC fell -50.00% on vol×7.51, with a 3.8σ volume spike and -50.00% intraday move. TRC rose +5.56% with an +8.57% intraday move, while SQ rose +6.25% on 0.32 times normal volume.

Activity was split: RML gained +12.50%, CGD +11.11%, ORI +5.29% and JCK +5.88%, while KC fell -33.33% and PF -20.00%. TPOLY gapped -10.00% at the open and moved +11.11% intraday after its disclosed debenture-interest default.
F&D fell -12.43% and -19.1% over five days, with volume at only 0.07 times average. BTG had a 6.4σ volume spike, alongside its filing on the acquisition of shares in an indirect subsidiary.
CCP opened at a -7.14% gap, while DCON had a +6.67% open gap followed by a -6.25% intraday move. DCON also filed a clarification regarding its request for Prinsiri to convene a meeting.
